title: State that components are logical capabilities, not products
requirements:
- Add a note that one platform may realise several components and one component may span systems
- Say prominently that a component is a logical capability, not a procurement or deployment unit
- Note that components may be procured together while preserving logical boundaries and interfaces
- Where one system realises several reference components, require separable services, data ownership and conformance scope
- Allow centralised, federated or hybrid authoritative arrangements with assigned stewardship and reconciliation
- Replace 'established once' with wording compatible with federated realisation
- State the permissible forms of national adaptation (adopt, combine, federate, defer) and emphasise capability coverage over name conformity
